tasks.subject: Task 1: Layout breakpoints helper
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A single source of truth for the width tiers, unit-tested.

**Files:** create app/lib/src/state/breakpoints.dart, app/test/state/breakpoints_test.dart.

**Acceptance Criteria:** layoutTierForWidth boundaries (compact <840, tablet [840,1200), desktop >=1200); BuildContext extension layoutTier/isWide/isDesktop; unit test passes.

**Verify:** cd app && flutter test test/state/breakpoints_test.dart

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/lib/src/state/breakpoints.dart", "app/test/state/breakpoints_test.dart"], "verifyCommand": "cd app && flutter test test/state/breakpoints_test.dart", "acceptanceCriteria": ["layoutTierForWidth boundaries correct", "context extension exposes layoutTier/isWide/isDesktop", "unit test passes"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Selection provider (selectedSource + resolvedSource)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** selectedSourceProvider (explicit pick) + resolvedSourceProvider (default + stale fallback), unit-tested.

**Files:** create app/lib/src/state/selected_source.dart, app/test/state/selected_source_test.dart; regenerate selected_source.g.dart via just gen.

**Acceptance Criteria:** default -> first active source; explicit existing group honored (even idle); stale selection falls back; no sources -> null.

**Verify:** cd app && flutter test test/state/selected_source_test.dart

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/lib/src/state/selected_source.dart", "app/lib/src/state/selected_source.g.dart", "app/test/state/selected_source_test.dart"], "verifyCommand": "cd app && flutter test test/state/selected_source_test.dart", "acceptanceCriteria": ["default resolves to first active source", "explicit existing selection honored", "stale selection falls back", "no sources -> null"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Split NowPlayingBody from NowPlayingScreen
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Make Now Playing embeddable (wide pane) while keeping the phone route; establishes the *Body/*Screen pattern.

**Files:** modify app/lib/src/ui/now_playing/now_playing_screen.dart; add a body-renders test under app/test/ui/.

**Acceptance Criteria:** NowPlayingBody({groupId, onDismiss}) renders content with no OtoScaffold; onDismiss null hides the chevron; NowPlayingScreen is a thin wrapper; existing tests pass (keys unchanged).

**Verify:** cd app && flutter test test/ui

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/lib/src/ui/now_playing/now_playing_screen.dart"], "verifyCommand": "cd app && flutter test test/ui", "acceptanceCriteria": ["NowPlayingBody chrome-free", "onDismiss null hides chevron", "thin NowPlayingScreen wrapper", "existing NowPlaying tests pass"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Wide Home shell (SPIKE GATE - grid + detail pane + selection)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Tablet master-detail (grid + Now Playing pane), select-in-place, bottom strip suppressed on wide. Milestone core; iterate via the showcase toggle, fold findings into spec §9.

**Files:** modify oto_scaffold.dart, home_screen.dart, group_card.dart, room_card.dart, room_row.dart; create now_playing_pane.dart, nav.dart; test wide_home_test.dart.

**Acceptance Criteria:** wide (>=840) grid+pane, no strip; phone (<840) unchanged; wide tap group/room selects into pane with accent border; empty-pane placeholder when no source.

**Verify:** cd app && flutter test test/ui/wide_home_test.dart

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/lib/src/ui/shell/oto_scaffold.dart", "app/lib/src/ui/now_playing/now_playing_pane.dart", "app/lib/src/ui/shell/nav.dart", "app/lib/src/ui/home/home_screen.dart", "app/lib/src/ui/home/group_card.dart", "app/lib/src/ui/home/room_card.dart", "app/lib/src/ui/home/room_row.dart", "app/test/ui/wide_home_test.dart"], "verifyCommand": "cd app && flutter test test/ui/wide_home_test.dart", "acceptanceCriteria": ["wide grid+pane no strip", "phone unchanged", "wide tap selects into pane with accent border", "empty pane placeholder"]}
```

**Acceptance Criteria:** rail (Home active + Settings) at >=1200, absent at 840-1200; Settings button routes through the tier-aware helper.

**Verify:** cd app && flutter test test/ui/wide_home_test.dart

tasks.subject: Task 7: Fold Room-detail away on wide; Settings & Group-editor as dialogs
tasks.description:

**Files:** modify settings_screen.dart, group_editor_screen.dart, room_detail_screen.dart, nav.dart, home_header.dart, group_card.dart; test dialog_nav_test.dart.

**Acceptance Criteria:** *Body widgets chrome-free with onDismiss header; thin *Screen wrappers; openSettings/openGroupEditor dialog-on-wide/route-on-phone; call sites route through helpers.

**Verify:** cd app && flutter test test/ui

tasks.subject: Task 8: Windows window-size persistence
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Restore last window size/position on Windows; persist on resize/move; no-op on Android.

**Files:** modify app/pubspec.yaml, app/lib/main.dart; create app/lib/src/platform/window_bounds.dart.

**Acceptance Criteria:** window_manager added, pub get clean; window restores saved bounds / centered default, persists to shared_preferences; Android path never calls window_manager.

**Verify:** cd app && flutter run -d windows (resize, quit, relaunch same size); just build-apk builds.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/pubspec.yaml", "app/lib/src/platform/window_bounds.dart", "app/lib/main.dart"], "verifyCommand": "cd app && flutter analyze && flutter run -d windows", "acceptanceCriteria": ["window_manager added, pub get clean", "restores + persists size/position", "Android never calls window_manager"]}
```
